definitions.ask: Should a `~<K>` list alone (for example `x~2`) also switch the close to explicit mode?
definitions.why: One rule (any number means you are listing) with no per-marker exception

choices.label: x~2 drops 2 and defers the rest (same as x0~2); write x1,3~2 to drop 2 and work 1 and 3
`~` only removes: x~2 drops 2 and every other link keeps its ledger default

definitions.ask: In explicit mode, should unlisted Event Task links defer instead of taking their clock default?
definitions.why: A clock default is still a default include; keeping it would restore an exception

choices.label: x!3 defers an unlisted meeting that ended inside the session; write x!1,3 to count it
Unlisted Event Tasks keep clock defaults in every mode, as a documented exception

definitions.ask: Add decision record close-selections-list-explicitly and mark the Event Task clock record superseded-in-part?
definitions.corrects: On a timed Pomodoro close, an unlisted plain Task Link to an Event Task ([[glossary:event-task]]) in the same canonical daily note is classified by its local span and the session start `S` and close time `C`

strands: Event Task Links Close By The Clock
